title: Calibration-guided robust reallocation of emergency resources under evolving flood risk forecasts: code, data and results (Kerala 2018 and 2019)
description: Code, processed inputs and results for the paper 'Calibration-guided robust reallocation of emergency resources under evolving flood risk forecasts: a digital twin framework' (D. Mounika and J. Kolluri, submitted to Natural Hazards). Includes the forecasting interface, temperature-scaling calibration, conformal prediction sets, robust allocation model, forecast-triggered re-planning, hindcast simulator, baselines B1-B5, FU, FC, ablations, Google Colab notebooks, result tables and the run log with input checksums.
